attached_files.extracted_text:
Talent Acquisition Assessment Task
Position: Senior Technical Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist
Time Limit: 48 Hours
Context: Our engineering organization is expanding its platform capabilities. We are opening a critical role: Senior DevSecOps & Cloud Platform Engineer.
Your objective is to demonstrate your end-to-end recruitment process across sourcing strategy, candidate outreach, initial screening, and stakeholder management.
Part 1: Sourcing Strategy & Boolean Search
Target Persona: Define 3 to 4 core criteria you will look for when identifying prospective candidates (e.g., tech stack depth, architectural scale, security governance).
Search Strings: Provide two distinct search strings you would use to source passive talent:
LinkedIn Recruiter Boolean String: Include key skills, tools, titles, and negative keywords (exclusions).
Alternative Platform / X-Ray Search: Construct a Google X-Ray search query to find candidates via GitHub, Stack Overflow, or personal tech blogs.
Part 2: Cold Candidate Outreach
Write an initial outreach message to a passive, highly sought-after Senior DevSecOps Engineer currently employed at a competitive firm.
Format: LinkedIn InMail or Cold Email.
Requirements:
Keep it concise (under 200 words).
Avoid generic recruitment templates.
Clearly articulate the value proposition, high-impact technical challenges, and a low-friction call to action.
Part 3: Structured Phone Screen Framework
Design a 30-minute initial screening questionnaire to evaluate candidates before passing them to the Hiring Manager. Provide 4 to 5 structured questions, specifying:
The exact question asked.
The competency or behavior being evaluated (e.g., technical depth, system ownership, cultural alignment, compensation expectations).
What constitutes a "strong answer" versus a "red flag."
Part 4: Hiring Manager Scenario & Stakeholder Management
Scenario:
Two weeks into the search, you have presented 6 qualified profiles who meet the initial job description requirements. The Hiring Manager rejects 5 of them at the resume stage without detailed feedback and leaves the 6th pending review for over 7 business days. Meanwhile, top passive candidates in your pipeline are receiving competing offers.
How do you address this bottleneck with the Hiring Manager?
Outline your agenda and talking points for a calibration/sync meeting to reset expectations, align on feedback, and protect the candidate experience.
Evaluation Criteria
Submissions will be assessed on:
Market Insight & Technical Literacy: Ability to understand technical terminology and accurately target relevant engineering profiles.
Communication & Engagement Quality: Tone, personalization, and clarity in candidate-facing communications.
Methodical Rigor: Structure, scoring consistency, and depth of the screening questions.
Consultative Influence: Professionalism and diplomacy in managing hiring managers and eliminating recruitment bottlenecks.
